diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says GND, datasheet reading says SDA
diffs.evidence: Adafruit #1334 EAGLE board file netlist: header JP1 (1X07) pad 1 = signal VIN, pad 2 = GND, pad 3 = +3V3, pad 4 = SCL_5V, pad 5 = SDA_5V, pad 6 = INT, pad 7 = LED_EN. Silkscreen (layer 21) labels at y=2.619 from x=17.0 down to x=1.6: VIN, GND, 3V3, SCL, SDA, INT, LED, matching the pad order. Pin 2 is GND (signal GND contactref JP1 pad 2). The second reading's order (3V3, SDA, SCL, GND, VIN, ...) was from memory, not a source.
